_contract: Single source of truth for what the BlueSkyz Labs portfolio website may publicly say about Sổ Trọ. The SGPS-Marketing repo (src/content/products/sotro.yaml) vendors a snapshot of this file pinned to an exact Sotro main revision and fails its own tests on drift. To change any public claim, change this file FIRST (via a reviewed Sotro PR), then re-vendor it in SGPS-Marketing at the new exact revision. Fields prefixed with an underscore are documentation for maintainers and must not be rendered publicly. Guard: tests/unit/public-profile.test.ts.

_rationale.availability: Committed production config (wrangler.jsonc env.production.vars) is PUBLIC_EXPOSURE_LEVEL=L0_INTERNAL, SELF_REGISTRATION_ENABLED=false, PAID_ORDERS_ENABLED=false; ADR-024 says L0_INTERNAL permits neither self-registration nor new paid orders and that promotion is adjacent and evidence-bound. So the product must not be described as publicly available, open for signup, or paid. The literal state is private, but the website enum rejects 'private' for a public listing; 'preview' is the least committal listing-compatible value and, with publicLabel 'In development', must be read as a look at a product under development, not as open access. Do not upgrade to public, invite-only or waitlist until exposure is promoted with evidence (no waitlist or invite flow exists in committed config).
_rationale.paid: Paid Go-Live is not approved; PAID_ORDERS_ENABLED=false in committed production config, so no price, plan or purchase claim may be published.
_rationale.capabilities: Only behaviour that is merged on main and has code plus a test in this repo. Reminder templates are copy-only (component header: no automatic sending); no claim is made that the app opens Zalo or SMS for the user.
_rationale.signInUrl: Committed production APP_BASE_URL is https://sotro.blueskyzlabs.com and src/app/router.tsx serves /login on the main (non-admin, non-super) host. This is a sign-in page for existing users; it is not evidence that signup is open.
